scope: Source-audited financing review for 20 published landscape identities. Thirteen new events are imported, two existing Fourth Law investor links are reconciled, and one Marduk amount correction is handled by a separate expected-old-value SQL manifest.

sources.title: Transaction counsel confirms OTB Ventures and Visionaries Club co-led Tytan's earlier seed financing

rounds.note_en: Transaction counsel for OTB Ventures confirms that OTB and Visionaries Club co-led the seed round. The date, amount and complete syndicate are not disclosed; the later EUR30m Series A remains separate.
rounds.coverage_note_en: Public company, investor and transaction-party history was checked. Tytan reports EUR46m total funding, but the amount and composition of earlier rounds remain only partially disclosed.
